hopeite: Chemical hopeite predates spores; fungal association does not prove necessity. Secondary crystals are spatial/morphological plus diffraction evidence, not a closed Zn/P mass balance.
Strongest selected observation is2000µM/day14. Day28pH2.8 versus2.5 and Discussion5–6 remain unresolved; Discussionmmol differs from Methodsµmol/L.
KF768341.1 verifies A.niger Ch4/07 annotation, not experimental reauthentication. OP758843.1 is P.granulatum II47-8 rather than P.chrysogenum Cs/21; companion mechanism not assigned.
Same experiment as katsarosite owner; no independent replication counted. Paper data statement says no new data despite experimental narrative.
whitlockite: Authoritative species identity separate from uncertain culture product: Mg-stabilized beta-TCP alternative visible in description/context/evidence.
Initial ACP precipitation and P removal also abiotic; sterile30day phase-null and filtrate15day null are conditional controls. No matched killed-cell arm.
30day phase comparison,39day composition and21day/four-culture protein work not merged. Sample washing differs;600°C2h Methods versus1h Results conflict preserved.

TOPAS profile fitting/lattice parameters do not supply refined phase purity; relative91.7/100% crystallinity is not recovery yield. Calcined FTIR and bulk composition cannot uniquely solve the uncalcined mineral assignment.
Model-urine2019 chemical whitlockite is distinct context, not replication or a quantitative microbial claim.
No pure isolated phosphorus product, demonstrated biomolecular cause or industrial/clinical deployment.
